slides.title: An ER flooded for 7-8 days
slides.body: A Mekelle surgeon told NPR that after fighting began in late September, war trauma patients filled the floors, with no phone network and no electricity.

slides.title: Doctors unpaid for months
slides.body: After the federal government cut funds to Tigray's regional administration, including its hospitals, doctors have not been paid in months, the surgeon said.

slides.title: women died in childbirth in the past year
slides.body: A Tigray health worker's count, citing lack of medicine, staff and fuel for ambulances. Not independently verified.

slides.title: of health workers reported attacks on ambulances
slides.body: PHR and OJAH survey of 600+ health workers in northern Ethiopia, covering 2020-2024. 57% saw an armed takeover of a clinic or hospital.

slides.title: Abuses by more than one side
slides.body: Researchers confirmed targeted attacks on health workers by both Tigrayan and government forces, NPR reports. Ethiopia's government did not respond to NPR.

slides.title: Protect health workers. Let medicine through.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
